0.symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings (target board pattern) primarily on older foliage.
0.prevention: Rotate crops every 2-3 years, use certified disease-free seeds, avoid overhead watering, and maintain adequate plant spacing.
0.general_management: Prune lower infected leaves, mulch soil around plant bases to prevent soil splash, and destroy heavily infested debris after harvest.

1.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular lesions on leaves that rapidly enlarge and turn dark brown to purplish with pale margins.
1.prevention: Ensure good air circulation, select resistant varieties, and avoid planting near potato fields carrying blight.
1.general_management: Promptly remove and destroy blighted plant parts during dry conditions. Avoid composting infected tissue.
1.treatment_guidance: Detailed treatment guidance is not available yet. Please consult a local agricultural expert.

2.symptoms: Brown circular spots with concentric rings on lower leaves, leading to leaf yellowing and premature defoliation.
2.prevention: Maintain balanced soil fertility, avoid moisture stress, and practice 3-year crop rotation.
2.general_management: Remove crop residue post-harvest and ensure optimal tuber hilling.
2.treatment_guidance: Detailed treatment guidance is not available yet. Please consult a local agricultural expert.

3.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions appearing on leaf tips and margins with white mildew under humid conditions.
3.prevention: Plant certified seed tubers, scout fields during cool humid periods, and destroy volunteer potato plants.
3.general_management: Kill foliage before harvest to prevent tuber contamination. Store tubers in dry, cool, well-ventilated areas.
3.treatment_guidance: Detailed treatment guidance is not available yet. Please consult a local agricultural expert.

4.symptoms: Circular dark brown to black spots surrounded by a prominent yellow halo on mature leaves.
4.prevention: Use clean disease-free seeds, practice crop rotation with cereals, and maintain proper crop hygiene.
4.general_management: Collect and burn infected plant residue after harvesting. Maintain adequate plant spacing for aeration.
4.treatment_guidance: Detailed treatment guidance is not available yet. Please consult a local agricultural expert.

5.symptoms: Yellowish-orange pustules arranged in linear stripes between leaf veins, producing powdery spores.
5.prevention: Sow rust-resistant varieties recommended by ICAR/State Agriculture Department.
5.general_management: Monitor fields early in the season during cool, humid weather and report outbreaks to local KVK.
5.treatment_guidance: Detailed treatment guidance is not available yet. Please consult a local agricultural expert.

6.symptoms: No visible signs of pathogen infection, foliar lesions, or nutrient deficiency.
6.prevention: Continue standard agronomic practices, balanced irrigation, and routine crop scouting.
6.general_management: Maintain soil health and monitor for seasonal pest activity.
6.treatment_guidance: No treatment required. Continue routine care.
